skills.name: SQLMap runtime: Verify bundled engine
skills.description: Confirm SQLMap is present in the app runtime rather than relying on a workspace package.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Query `runtime.sqlmap.status` and confirm the bundled version and private runtime path.
2. If the pack is absent or incomplete, call `runtime.sqlmap.install`; it unpacks the APK asset without pip download or root.
3. Use `runtime.sqlmap.status`; accept READY only when the report names a version and an app-private path under `filesDir/runtimes/sqlmap`.
4. Preserve the upstream license and keep engine files separate from workspace scan artifacts.

Safety: use only owner-authorized targets. For scans, use web.sqlmap with uthorized_target=true, app defaults, and no data dumping, shells, server file access, tamper/evasion, or destructive options.
